rules.name: THE BEHEMOTH RISES
rules.text: You have an Incarna ( [Ember-Eyed Behemoth] ). Once per turn, during the Spirit, [Fasticon] , or [Slowicon] phase, you may either: Push [Ember-Eyed Behemoth] ; or Add or Move [Ember-Eyed Behemoth] to any of your [Sacred Site] on the island.
rules.turn:
#acc rises-used : spirit @sum
spirit:special S behemoth-rises / rises-used S 0
rises-use S A / rises-used S 1
#acc rises-limit : spirit @sum
spirit:special S behemoth-rises / rises-limit S 1

-- "during the Spirit, Fast, or Slow phase, you may"
spirit-phase, spirit:special S behemoth-rises, ~rises-offer S
fast-phase, spirit:special S behemoth-rises, ~rises-offer S
slow-phase, spirit:special S behemoth-rises, ~rises-offer S

-- "either: Push [Incarna]; or Add or Move [Incarna] to any of your Sacred Sites"
#acc rises-option : spirit e
rises-offer S / rises-option S decline
rises-offer S, incarna-of S I, at I L, land L / rises-option S push
rises-offer S, sacred-site S L / rises-option S (to L)
rises-offer S, rises-used S U, rises-limit S Lim, lt U Lim
  ?[rng] A
  !(rises-option S A)
  ~rises-choice S A
-- a use is recorded inside the choice episode, so later reads see it
-- (+ to top: in a multi-turn game this would need a turn key); after a use
-- the same phase may offer again (only matters with Strides). The re-offer
-- is nested in the choice: `rises-offer S, >rises-choice S C, ...` would also
-- match choices of earlier offers (>p needs no overlap) and loop.
rises-choice S C, is C A, neq A decline
  +rises-use S A
  ~>rises-act S A
  ~rises-offer S
rises-act S push, incarna-of S I, at I L, ~push S I L
rises-act S (to L), incarna-of S I, ~move I L
rules.evidence: 8 seeds: 0-2 uses per turn (e.g. seed 1: rises-report l3 then push, move eeb l3 then l2); options are decline / push / (to <Sacred Site>).
rules.notes: 'Once per turn' = a use counter (@sum with a 0 row for 'unused') compared with an allowance (@sum, so Strides can add 1). The offer happens in each of the three phases with a decline option. Uses are recorded with + inside the choice episode; in a multi-turn game they would need a turn key (no 'until end of turn' fact that is also visible to later reads without floating).

rules.name: UNRELENTING STRIDES
rules.text: On any turn that you don't use Innate Powers, you may use The Behemoth Rises an additional time. (When you use an Innate Power, cover this Special Rule with a Reminder Marker; when you use this Special Rule, cover your Innate Power.)
rules.turn:
#acc innate-used : spirit @sum
spirit S / innate-used S 0
used-innate S P / innate-used S 1
use-power S P, power:innate P, +used-innate S P
spirit:special S unrelenting, innate-used S 0 / rises-limit S 1
-- "when you use this Special Rule, cover your Innate Power": once the extra
-- use is taken, Innate Powers are not used.
slow-phase, spirit:special S unrelenting, rises-used S U, ge U 2, power:innate P,
  { use-power S P => }
fast-phase, spirit:special S unrelenting, rises-used S U, ge U 2, power:innate P,
  { use-power S P => }
rules.evidence: Seeds 1,3,5,6: two uses, Innate not used; seeds 2,4,8: one use, use-power behemoth smash; seed 7: no use, Innate used. Never two uses plus the Innate.
rules.notes: The physical 'cover' markers are a mutual exclusion; Turn expresses it as a conditional extra allowance row (no Innate used yet) plus an exception that drops the Innate's use-power once 2 uses happened. Concurrency caveat: a Slow-phase offer and the Slow Innate start at the same moment, so both read 'unused'.

base_ext: Innate Powers modeled as played powers with power:innate; Incarna as a presence-of row and incarna-of fact; push reused from core.
language_issues: `P, >q ...` matches any earlier q, not just ones inside P (>q needs no overlap): a re-offer rule `rises-offer S, >rises-choice S C, ~rises-offer S` matched choices from previous offers and looped until gas; nesting the re-offer inside the choice episode fixed it.
Choice values that are compound terms (to l3) render as opaque refs (*6334) in output; reports have to destructure them.
'Once per turn' needs either negation or a counter; @sum with an explicit 0 row is the idiom (bool acc relations have no absent row to match).
